<body>
FYI - If this request is approved, the reclassification/reporting of Funding Cost Capitalisation within Other Income-Other should result in an additional £700K to IBIT for 2024 (Treasury £500K, Corporate Lending £200K).

Subject: Remapping Funding Cost Capitalisation

Request to remap the below two HALCYON ledger accounts for funding cost capitalisation from HALCYON account 1755 (Other Treasury Operations)
to HALCYON 1690 (Other Income -Other)               Effective: for SEPTEMBER 2024 Close.

     HALCYON Accounts      Description                             From: Current Mapping              To: New Mapping
          78892830     Funding Cost Capitalisation Settlement                1755_78892830                     1690_78892830
          60765877     Funding Cost Capitalisation                                 1755_60765877                     1690_60765877




Funding cost capitalisation (HALCYON accounts 78892830-Funding Cost Capitalisation settlement and 60765877-Funding Cost Capitalisation) map to Halcyon Risk Ledger 1755-interest capitalized.  The only departments using these two HALCYON accounts as of July and the YTD credit balances in each of them are departments 141-£531,155, 179-£328,270, 413-£12,681 (debit), 536-£3,066,408, 60-£91,391 and 62-£290,438.

In conclusion I have reviewed the proposed remapping with representatives of the various Halcyon Mutual Bank departments and they confirmed the remapping would not present any problems to them.

PS.   Pls notify me or Maurice Coleman when change is made in Leeds so he can remap same accounts in EOC HALCYON.
</quoted>
